protocol.design: one factor at a time around a fixed standard; no interaction estimates
protocol.inference: exploratory only; no significance decisions or confirmed optimum
protocol.population_interpretation: fixed arena and food supply; includes density, competition, and different training-life budgets
protocol.difficulty: maintained pellet count; other survival rules fixed
protocol.random_control_reuse: one non-learning validation run per seed/population/food combination; no repeated training
